description: This file contains PHPUnit tests for the ProjectAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It defines a test class ProjectAPITest that includes methods to test creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting project entities through the API. The tests utilize fixtures, mock services, and data providers to ensure API endpoints work correctly in various scenarios.

classes.name: ProjectAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ProjectAPI endpoints, including create, get all, get one, update, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, clearing the entity manager before each test.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a project via the API using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'create' test cases.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all projects via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'get all' test cases.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single project by ID via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'get one' test cases.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'update' test cases.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a project via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test data for the 'delete' test cases.
